notes.title: The Collective: Sneak peak
notes.content: [p]We've been working hard on our third faction: The Collective. [/p][p][/p][p]The Collective is a faction for RTS newcomers primarily. Or people who just don't enjoy multitasking that much. It is a very automated faction meaning the player primarily just has to place buildings while drones to the rest: [/p][list][*][p]Drones automatically stockpile[/p][/*][*][p]If a threat is nearby drones attempt to neutralize it[/p][/*][*][p]All drones can be set to automatic, stockpile, defend, or attack[/p][/*][*][p]Drones can not be controlled directly[/p][/*][/list][p]Later on we will be adding a few units and abilities that gives the player some more agency. But overall this is the least 'classic RTS faction' we have. The United Federation and Eastern Alliance however are fully classic, so there's things to do for everyone![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W-8fAaA9zRA&feature=youtu.be"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Anyway, make sure you check out the video and subscribe to our youtube as well. The youtube description also has a link where you can support the project as well as get rewards.[/p][p]See you on the field Commander![/p]
